description: Cut a shot (shot_id, or scene + shot; left out: the shot on screen) in two at a time, like a clip in an editor: both parts together play exactly what the shot played; the second keeps the transition and the voice stays in the first. Times round to 0.1 s and must be at least 0.2 s from either edge. Returns { first, second } shot ids. One undo step for the person. To change only the length, use edit_project on seconds.

at.description: Seconds into the shot where it's cut.

scene.description: Scene index from 0 (with shot). Used when shot_id isn't given.

shot.description: Shot index from 0 inside that scene (with scene; alone: in the scene on screen). A shot id works here too.

shot_id.description: The shot's id from get_project. Or give scene and shot instead. Left out: the shot on screen.

name: cut_shot
